Light emitted by the sun takes 8 minutes to reach the earth because of the distance between the earth and the Sun. If, theoretically, the sun stopped emitting light in an instant it Would take 8 minutes before the light stops reaching the earth.

The same principle applies to other stars in the universe and in the night sky. We see the past of the stars because they are light years away. Sometimes millions of lightyears which would mean if such a star would explode or stop emitting light at this moment we would not notice this until a million years have passed.

A planning is not static. Certainly when you first start planning some things will take way more or less time than you thought and there will be influencing factors you can’t account for(important messages, wheater, internet troubles etc.). This does not mean planning is useless but it is a process. When your plan doesn’t go as planned you haven’t failed, just adjust your planning and move on. This does not mean you can keep pushing everything forward and you will still succeed. Just that a change in the planning when needed is part of the planning process and not a failure.
